Summary: Large North American critical infrastructure operator evaluating Redwood Private for on‑prem, air‑gapped inference to replace brittle scripted NLP workflows. They run 24/7 NOC/ICS monitoring and need and want LLM assistance inside their secure enclave. Primary ask: fully offline, no egress, HSM-backed key material, audit trail for every inference, and deterministic upgrade path.

Key stakeholders: CISO (Amanda Liu), Head of OT Engineering (Marcus Lee), Procurement lead (Tara Nguyen), Program Security Officer (PSO) - multiple stakeholders must sign off.

Technical constraints / must-haves (customer language):
- "No internet egress from inference nodes; updates via signed images only."
- HSM/KMS support mirrored on air-gapped HSM appliance; FIPS 140-2 preference.
- Audit logs retained 7 years, immutable storage, per-request correlation id required.
- Ability to pin model versions and rollback controlled via offline artifact repository.
- Restricted container runtime, SBOM and signed kernel modules.
- Network segmentation: inference cluster sits on isolated VLAN with jump host for ops.
- Export control check required for certain model weights — legal flagged.

- Phase 0: Security deep dive and architecture workshop (complete 2026-02-28).
- Phase 1: Deliver hardened OVA/container image + installation checklist for air-gapped lab (deliver by 2026-03-20).
- Phase 2: On-site install in customer lab and acceptance testing (2-week window; tentative Apr 6).
- Phase 3: Performance tuning and quantized model validation; latency SLO target 150ms p50 for short prompts, burst throughput 120 req/s.
